current_checks: owner business permission in write transaction
expiry_precision: Round down to a whole UTC second before hashing or issuing; never extend the Action request deadline.
replay: One immutable preparation per Action; one dated durable consume per tenant/jti. A consumed or expired token is never replaced on identical retry.
cancellation: Persist a separate command; never erase success or unresolved effects. Compensation requires a separately registered and authorized Action with its own confirmation.
tier: contract-scripted and isolated-postgres; synthetic host/owner only
